fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of your app registered at apps.developer.allegro.pl; sent with the secret as HTTP Basic on the token call.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client Secret of the same app.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code (or device-flow) consent of the seller account (valid 3 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new pair (access token 12 h + new refresh token) and the old refresh token stops working 60 seconds after its first use. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token. The state file is keyed by platform id, so it is shared with ecommerce_channels/allegro: give each server its own PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR (or its own consent / refresh token) so the two never race on one single-use refresh token.

adapter.terms: Allegro seller REST API; amounts are decimal strings in the offer / order currency (PLN on allegro.pl).

me.note: GET /me (scope allegro:api:profile:read) returns the authorised user {id, login, firstName, lastName, email, baseMarketplace, company}.

list_products.note: GET /sale/offers?offset&limit(1-1000)&publication.status (INACTIVE|ACTIVE|ACTIVATING|ENDED; scope allegro:api:sale:offers:read) lists the seller's offers: {offers[{id, name, sellingMode.price {amount (decimal string), currency}, stock, stats, publication.status, primaryImage ...}], count, totalCount}. There is no description or URL in the list (see raw / get_product).

get_product.note: GET /sale/product-offers/{offerId} returns all data of the offer; `description` is a structured sections object (raw.description) and is not flattened, so the mapped description is null.

update_price.note: CHANGES THE LIVE PRICE: PATCH /sale/product-offers/{offerId} {sellingMode: {price: {amount (sent as the documented decimal string), currency}}} edits only the price; pass `currency` (PLN on allegro.pl). Answers 200 (edited, offer in the body) or 202 (accepted, still processing - the body may be empty and GET /sale/product-offers/{offerId}/operations/{operationId} tracks it).

list_sales.note: GET /order/checkout-forms?offset&limit(1-100)&lineItems.boughtAt.gte=`since` (ISO-8601 date-time) sorted newest first (scope allegro:api:orders:read). `amount` is summary.totalToPay (decimal string, whole order incl. delivery), product_id / product_name are the FIRST line item's offer; `status` is the purchase status (BOUGHT|FILLED_IN|READY_FOR_PROCESSING|CANCELLED). Orders cannot be filtered by offer: `product_id` is not sent.

list_refunds.note: GET /payments/refunds?offset&limit(1-100)&occurredAt.gte=`since` (ISO-8601 date-time; scope allegro:api:payments:read): refunds {id, payment.id, order.id, reason, status (WAITING|IN_PROGRESS|SUCCESS|CANCELED|...), totalValue {amount, currency}, lineItems, createdAt}. sale_id is the order (checkout form) id.

not_offered.create_product: POST /sale/product-offers needs productSet[{product: {id, idType}}] (an Allegro catalogue product or a new product with category.id and required parameters), delivery shipping rates and after-sales policies (https://developer.allegro.pl/documentation#operation/createProductOffers); the vocabulary carries none of these ids.
not_offered.get_sales_stats: The REST API has no revenue summary endpoint; sales exist only as individual checkout forms (https://developer.allegro.pl/documentation#operation/getListOfOrdersUsingGET).
not_offered.refund: POST /payments/refunds requires payment.id, a reason and per-line-item quantities or values (lineItems[] with the checkout form's line item ids) (https://developer.allegro.pl/documentation#operation/initiateRefund); a sale id and a single amount cannot express it.

evidence: host api.allegro.pl: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://developer.allegro.pl/swagger.yaml: 6/6 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
